subject: history_social
passage: Much of the Netherlands consists of polders, areas of low land surrounded by dikes, which are earthen walls that hold back rivers and the sea. Many polders lie below sea level, so rainwater and water seeping through the ground collect in them instead of draining away. Beginning in the 1400s, the Dutch built windmills that lifted this water over the dikes. Without some way to remove water, the polders would most likely ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: dry out and become too dusty to farm.
choices.B: rise slowly above the level of the sea.
choices.C: need fewer dikes to keep out the sea.
choices.D: gradually fill with water and flood.

explanation.why: Water collects in the polders because they are low and cannot drain on their own. The windmills removed that water, so without them it would keep building up.
explanation.A: Incorrect. This reverses the problem: polders collect water rather than lose it.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Nothing in the text suggests the land would rise.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Nothing in the text links removing water to the number of dikes needed; the dikes hold back rivers and the sea, which would still be there.
explanation.D: Correct. Water collects in the polders and cannot drain away, so without pumping it would build up until the land flooded.
